name: Spiko US T-Bills Money Market Fund
oneLiner: USTBL is Spiko's regulated short-term U.S. Treasury fund tokenized for EU and global investors under an AMF-authorized UCITS money market structure.
collateral: Short-dated U.S. Treasury bills and operational bank balances held by an AMF-authorized UCITS short-term VNAV money market fund, with a regulatory weighted-average maturity ceiling of 60 days
pegMechanism: USD-denominated NAV-accreting share token (ISIN FR001400ODM9) of the Spiko SICAV short-term VNAV money market sub-fund authorised by the AMF, invested in short-dated U.S. Treasury bills and operational bank balances with a regulatory weighted-average maturity ceiling of 60 days; subscription and redemption are KYC-gated to allowlisted wallets through Spiko's transfer agent with a daily 11:30 Paris cutoff settling at the day's published NAV (next-business-day clearing for late orders) and a $1 prospectus minimum. The management company may gate redemptions at a 10% net-assets threshold for up to 20 NAVs over three months, with a maximum one-month duration; electronic-money-token redemptions may not settle the same day. Chainlink CCIP interoperability was announced, but no production adapter was identified in the reviewed sources. Prospectus: https://cdn.spiko.finance/legal_docs/EN/Prospectus_Spiko_SICAV_EN.pdf

proofOfReserves.provider: PricewaterhouseCoopers Audit, statutory auditor of the Spiko SICAV certifying annual accounts (prospectus art. 24: financial-statement certification and pre-publication asset-composition checks). AMF GECO publishes the fund's 2026-06-30 semiannual report, which names PwC but does not contain an audit opinion; a current dated annual auditor report was not verified.

notices.message: USTBL's prospectus lists issuer-native deployments on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon, Base, Etherlink, Stellar, Starknet, and Solana. Spiko announced Chainlink CCIP interoperability; production adapter and lane controls were not identified in the reviewed sources.
